generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `testSystemDataStreamAliasesAreAlwaysRestored` contains a comment and a TODO explicitly stating that the test is failing. Known-failing tests should not be merged into the codebase; they should either be fixed or properly disabled (e.g., using `@Ignore`) with a reference to a tracking issue.

The `clusterState` helper method in `MetadataDataStreamsServiceTests` contains a TODO to add a second project. Since `MetadataDataStreamsService.deleteDataStreams` introduces logic specifically to handle multiple projects, the test suite should include a multi-project scenario to verify that the grouping and deletion logic works correctly across different project boundaries.

The implementation of `lookupProject(DataStream)` only checks the default project via `getProject()`. This contradicts the multi-project design intended in `MetadataDataStreamsService.deleteDataStreams`, which attempts to group data streams by their respective projects. If a data stream exists in a non-default project, these methods will fail to find it, rendering the multi-project logic in the service layer ineffective.

review_comment: Just commenting on this line so we don't forget this TODO. I don't know enough about (partial) snapshots to know if this is something we need to cover. @dakrone, any thoughts?
I'm not sure how we'd even set this up to test this.  Any ideas?

A partial snapshot would be one where some of the shards were snapshotted and others weren't. If we take a snapshot with `partial: true` while the index is red (say it had two primaries and one were unavailable) that would cause a partial snapshot.

It would probably be good to test this as well, since we test it for regular system indices.
